<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that forms a carbon‑carbon double bond between an aryl ring and an alkene (a Heck‑type coupling). This could allow the target to be assembled in one step from a vinyl halide bearing the ester‑cyclopropyl‑SiMe₃ fragment and a simple aryl boronic/aryl halide. We'll look for templates that create a 6‑6 bond (aryl‑alkene).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
